openness.public: This instance is considered an open instance.
openness.private: This instance is considered a closed instance.
openness.unknown: We couldn't confirm whether this instance is open or closed.
openness.groupPublic: This instance is considered an open instance.
openness.groupPlus: This instance is considered an open instance.
openness.groupPlusCvr: This instance is considered an open instance.
openness.groupOnly: This instance is considered a closed instance.

more.public: Anyone can walk into a public instance — treat it as a fully open space.
more.friendsPlus: Friends of anyone already inside can join, so the crowd can be wider than your own friend list. Treat it as open.
more.private: Only friends of people inside — or players holding an invite — can get in. It's still not a private channel: the instance owner and moderators can see everything.
more.unknown: VRX couldn't read this instance's privacy, so it can't say how open it is. Treat it as open.
more.groupPublic: This instance of {{group}} is open to everyone, not just group members — treat it as a fully open space.
more.groupPlus: Group+ admits group members plus friends of anyone currently in the instance, so the crowd can be wider than your own friend list. Treat it as open.
more.groupPlusCvr: You don't need to be in {{group}}: friends of its members can join, so the crowd can be wider than your own friend list. Treat it as open.
more.groupOnly: Only {{group}} members can get in — friendship and invites don't apply here. It's still not a private channel: group staff and moderators can see everything.
